selection: Both candidates fixed before inference. All 200 synthetic DEV captures / 800 OCR frames; all three Synthesized DEV variants and separate native text diagnostic. No training or parameter fitting. FATURA/Bankstatemently are source-audited follow-ups, not semantic POA truth in this run.
change: Only document_type postprocessing. Other fields, frame selection and shipped verification are preserved. No production changes.
capture_type: Apply candidate to each shipped picked frame. Replace capture type only if one type has strict majority of picked frames; otherwise preserve baseline. Single frame candidate independent of customer.
referees: Use existing unchanged public_poa field_scores/aggregate_rows and bench suites.poa.score. Separate supplemental exact document-type metric because existing synthetic referee does not score that field.
failures: Never drop an item; missing prediction fails type and fields. A missing frame votes other, not bank. Process failure records error and retains denominator; no valid negative rejection credited.
metrics: Paired per-item exact booleans, recovered/regressed and false-bank classifications, denominators. All candidates reported; no confidence interval over three correlated variants. Existing key-field and customer metrics retained. No speed claim.
privacy: No source media/text/embeddings/predicted identity values in repository. Only opaque IDs, hashes, categorical class outcomes and correctness flags.
scope: Research-inspired heuristic ablations, not reproductions of Docling, KNN-former, GraphRevisedIE or VLMs. US address schema is unchanged and unsupported. No ZIP truncation or forced ZA province. No TEST/reserved access.
